known_analyses_and_limits: The source reports cesium ion collection, EIT and thermal/electrical noise comparisons. Peak reversal and double-Lorentzian fits are prior art. We use only Figure3b's author-released gridded ion-readout map, not its fitted linewidth/amplitude tables or sensitivity fits. The 300 equally spaced Rabi coordinates are source-defined conditions, not independent cell replicates. Interpolation/averaging lineage is not fully specified; adjacent points must not be treated as independent experiments. The fixed detuning neighborhood ±60MHz targets the calibrated43D5/2 feature. Broader43D3/2 data and optical traces are outside this task. Source README incorrectly calls the ion amplitude EIT in one format description; CSV header and figure define it as ion readout. The amplitude is arbitrary units, not calibrated current. Unknown measurement dates; published2025, source web manuscript date later modified. Collected spectral line shapes cannot identify a microscopic ionization pathway by themselves.
novelty_search_limit: Targeted primary-source review only; no exhaustive novelty clearance or independent scientific adjudication.
